settings.a: No. It is 100% heavy faux leather (PU) with a polyester lining. No animal leather, and it wipes clean with a damp cloth.

Standard thickness: made for spring, autumn and mild winter days. When it's freezing, layer a hoodie underneath.
It ships with tracking and usually arrives in 7–17 business days. The exact window is shown by the buy button.
